name: Indian Coastal Marine Geofences & Restricted Maritime Zones

metadata.source: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) & Directorate General of Shipping (DGS)
metadata.description: Marine Protected Areas (MPAs), defense operational zones, and environmental conservation boundaries

properties.name: Gahirmatha Marine Wildlife Sanctuary
properties.description: Strict conservation zone for Olive Ridley turtle mass nesting (Arribada). Mechanized trawling and gillnetting strictly prohibited by State Fisheries Act.

properties.name: Bombay High Offshore Energy Security Perimeter
properties.description: 500-meter safety zone around offshore oil production platforms and subsea pipelines. Trawling, anchoring, and unauthorized entry prohibited.

properties.name: Malvan Marine Wildlife Sanctuary
properties.description: Core marine sanctuary protecting submerged coral reefs, pearl oysters, and sea anemones. Destructive drag-net fishing prohibited.

properties.name: Gulf of Mannar Marine Biosphere Core
properties.description: Biodiversity hotspot housing dugongs, sea turtles, and pristine coral shoals. Regulated traditional artisanal fishing only.

properties.name: Visakhapatnam Eastern Naval Operational Corridor
properties.description: Submarine approach lane and deep draft naval vessel maneuver corridor. Non-commercial crafts must keep clear and maintain VHF watch.
